title: WaterColor 72 Buttercup Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $55/day- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 9 wristbands. - Located on a charming, quiet street - 3-minute walk to the WaterColor Beach Club (0.2 miles) and a 2-3 minute walk to Watercolor Bike Barn, Marina Park Amphitheater, Boathouse (kayaks, canoes, paddle boards) and LakeHouse pool. Less than 1- minute from beautiful Cerulean Park and a 5-minute walk to Seaside.- Flat screen TVs throughout (All 3 bedrooms and living room)- Outdoor shower- 4 adult bikes- Keurig coffee machine (as well as traditional machine)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Discover peace and charm at 72 Buttercup Street, a beautiful 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom WaterColor home, sleeping 9 guests. Ideally located along a quiet street, this 2-level home is only a 3-minute walk from the famous WaterColor Beach Club, Boathouse, and Marina Park Amphitheater. Enjoy days strolling over to nearby Seaside, relaxing by the private pool, and enjoying the effortless luxury of this 30A community!A lovely dove gray exterior and a spacious front porch set the mood for a delightful getaway upon arrival. Picture slow-paced mornings sipping coffee on the Adirondack chairs or breakfasting at the 6-person table, while the ceiling fans provide a cooling breeze. Inside, contemporary coastal décor, hardwood floors, shiplap wainscotting, a soaring ceiling, and tons of natural light feature throughout the great room. The open-concept layout makes it easy for everyone to feel connected and relaxed, whether unwinding in the living area—furnished with 2 soft couches, 2 matching armchairs, and a TV—or gathering at the 6-person dining table. The kitchen boasts plenty of counter space and high-end appliances, including a Keurig and a drip coffee machine. A vaulted screened-in porch with a TV, comfy patio furniture, and bar seating encourages blissful afternoons. The backyard is a stylish oasis, complete with a sitting spa, private pool with a sun shelf, and Tupelo Goods loungers. Relax on the submerged pool seating—or dine alfresco at the 8-seat table as the water feature provides a tranquil soundtrack. For convenience, there’s a grill and an outdoor shower for rinsing off sandy feet and beach toys. Guests can retire to the primary bedroom or guest bedroom, each with a king bed and outdoor access.Upstairs, a bunk room with a full-over-queen bed, twin sleeper chair, and private bathroom offers fun and flexible sleeping accommodations.With the beach minutes away, a private pool, and luxe outdoor spaces, 72 Buttercup Street is a dreamy WaterColor escape. There’s parking for 2 vehicles or hop on the 4 complimentary adult bikes for laid-back exploration. Beach access can be found at the WaterColor Beach Club or on Goldenrod Circle past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 9):FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom, Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom, Shower/Tub combo- Half BathroomSECOND FLOOR-Guest Room: Double over Queen Bunk Bed, Twin Pull out Sleeper Chair, Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub ComboTV streaming onlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental paym
